title: Mitochondria-targeted tetraoxanes initiate lipid peroxidation to drive ferroptosis and tumor suppression
title_zh: 线粒体靶向四氧烷诱导脂质过氧化以驱动铁死亡并抑制肿瘤
abstract: Ferroptosis is implicated as a vulnerability in multiple cancers, yet approaches for effectively inducing ferroptosis in vivo are limited. Bypassing conventional strategies targeting the antiferroptotic glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4) and ferroptosis suppressor protein 1 (FSP1) proteins, we designed metabolic initiators of lipid peroxidation (MILPOs) and developed the compounds WMK-1/2, which contain tetraoxane radical-generating and mitochondria-targeting groups, as de novo ferroptosis inducers. WMK-1 localizes primarily to mitochondria, induces local lipid peroxidation, and impairs oxidative phosphorylation. WMK-1 induces a "mito-ferroptosis" sub-pathway that skips GPX4 inhibition as a prerequisite, can be rescued by lipophilic radical-trapping antioxidants, yet is minimally sensitive to acyl-coenzyme A synthetase long-chain family member 4 (ACSL4) perturbation and long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) supplementation, and evades retinol-mediated protection. Instead, WMK-1-induced cell death requires labile Fe2+ and can be selectively suppressed by ɑ-lipoic acid, an endogenous, mitochondria-resident antioxidant. WMK-1/2 are bioavailable and exhibit significant efficacy in tumor suppression by eliciting ferroptosis in multiple cancer models and augmenting the antitumor effects of immune-checkpoint blockers. Our work provides a protein-targeting-independent metabolic ferroptosis induction strategy for potential cancer therapy.
abstract_zh: 铁死亡被认为是多种癌症的脆弱点，但在体内有效诱导铁死亡的方法仍然有限。我们通过绕过传统靶向抗铁死亡谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）和铁死亡抑制蛋白1（FSP1）的策略，设计了脂质过氧化代谢启动剂（MILPOs），并开发了含有四氧烷自由基生成和线粒体靶向基团的化合物WMK‑1/2，作为全新铁死亡诱导剂。WMK‑1主要定位于线粒体，诱导局部脂质过氧化并损害氧化磷酸化。WMK‑1诱导一种“线粒体铁死亡”亚通路，该通路跳过GPX4抑制的前提，可被脂溶性自由基捕获抗氧化剂拯救，但对长链酰基辅酶A合成酶4（ACSL4）扰动和长链多不饱和脂肪酸（PUFA）补充的敏感性极低，并能逃避视黄醇介导的保护。相反，WMK‑1诱导的细胞死亡需要易变的Fe2+，并可被α-硫辛酸（一种内源性线粒体驻留抗氧化剂）选择性抑制。WMK‑1/2具有良好的生物利用度，并在多种癌症模型中通过诱导铁死亡显著抑制肿瘤，同时增强免疫检查点抑制剂的抗肿瘤效果。我们的研究提供了一种不依赖蛋白靶向的代谢铁死亡诱导策略，具有潜在的癌症治疗前景。
